The step-2 evidence upload screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` (default export) and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- Step indicator shows "Step 2 of 3 — Upload evidence" with Policy details marked done.
- Mock data has 4 files (2 photos, 1 PDF uploaded; 1 photo failed with a shown reason: "exceeds the 5 MB size limit").
- Each file row shows name, size (or the failure reason), and a remove button; adding is capped at 5 total via a file picker that reads real `name`/`size` from selected files (no network, per "no backend").
- Continue is disabled until at least one file has `status: 'uploaded'`; Back is always available.
- Styling uses the two confirmed Strata tokens (`--strata-color-surface-canvas`, `--strata-color-text-default`, `--strata-font-body`, `--strata-space-6`) plus `var(...)` fallbacks for other token names (accent, danger, radius, spacing scale) so it degrades gracefully if those exact names don't exist, and uses logical properties for RTL.

I couldn't run or typecheck the app since I only had access to this folder (no `node_modules`), so please run `pnpm install && pnpm dev` (or `typecheck`) to verify.
